technical.title: Voxel51 3.0 launches as a unified multimodal data platform for physical AI.
technical.summary: Voxel51 3.0 merges multimodal sensor data search, curation, annotation, and evaluation into a single platform for physical AI teams, adding the Voxel51 Agent with over 45 MCP tools and dataset versioning.
technical.why: It streamlines multimodal data management pipelines for computer vision and robotics engineering.

technical.title: Kyutai releases REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model for robot manipulation.
technical.summary: Kyutai, along with Inria and École des Ponts, released REKI, a 2.4B VLA model pretrained on public data that includes efficient memory of its recent past to compete with models twice its size on robot manipulation.
technical.why: Efficient small-scale VLA models lower compute barriers for robotics and autonomous manipulation research.

technical.title: Researchers introduce semCER, a severity-weighted character error rate for OCR models.
technical.summary: Researchers introduced semCER, a metric that weights character errors by severity using an LLM judge rather than treating all typos equally. It better aligns with human ratings for OCR and vision-language model transcripts compared to standard CER.
technical.why: It offers a more human-aligned evaluation metric for computer vision and OCR pipelines.

technical.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduces a framework for evaluating autonomous AI agents.
technical.summary: This post shares a nine-stage production evaluation framework built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to catch silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle from first commit to production.
technical.why: Production evaluation frameworks help prevent quality degradation in deployed agentic systems.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an 816B mixture-of-experts coding model.
technical.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, a coding-optimized 816B mixture-of-experts model featuring 42B active parameters and a 1M token context window, optimized for agentic workflows.
technical.why: Large open-weight MoE models expand capabilities for advanced coding agents.

technical.title: New test-time diversity alignment approach improves generative model output variation.
technical.summary: Researchers introduce MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER, a test-time approach that externalizes diversity into a corpus-derived sampling procedure. It mines an interpretable categorical schema and uses the generative model purely as a conditional renderer of sampled configurations.
technical.why: This technique helps generative models overcome diversity bottlenecks during test-time deployment.

technical.title: Automatic framework hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking.
technical.summary: Researchers propose a scalable, fully automatic weak-to-strong verifier hardening approach to prevent exploitable programmatic verifiers from awarding full credit to cheating LLM agents during training.
technical.why: Robust verifiers are critical for preventing reward hacking as agent training environments scale.

technical.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
technical.summary: Google Research released Harness2, an Apache-2.0 framework that rewrites an agent's harness at test time. One refinement step lifted GLM-5 performance significantly without weight updates.
technical.why: Test-time harness optimization provides a lightweight way to boost agent performance.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
technical.summary: Always-on agents are taking on longer, more complex enterprise workflows, requiring multimodal reasoning across diverse sources and documents.
technical.why: Advanced multimodal models enable more capable enterprise AI agents.

technical.title: Reflection AI's Beam open-weight model deployed for agentic coding on AWS.
technical.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, which can be deployed on AWS using SageMaker JumpStart endpoints or HyperPod infrastructure with SGLang and vLLM.
technical.why: Provides practical infrastructure deployment paths for open-weight coding agents.

business.title: Nvidia veteran views physical AI robotics in its Lego era
business.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, a former Nvidia robotics product marketing leader, states robotics is in its Lego era while basic building blocks like actuators, hands, and software are rebuilt.
business.why: Understanding hardware and component maturity helps you gauge timelines for autonomous driving and physical AI deployments.

business.title: Elorian releases Glimpse model for advanced visual reasoning
business.summary: Elorian's new model Glimpse aims to reason with images rather than just about them, outperforming GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning.
business.why: Advances in multi-modal visual reasoning directly impact computer vision and video understanding capabilities.

business.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Spending Contracts For Latest AI-Driven Startup Batch
business.summary: Startup investors aren’t exactly hitting pause, but they did scale back on giant rounds this past week, with just two startup financings in the multiple hundreds of millions.

business.title: AI stocks plunge. Inflation heats up. Where we're still finding opportunities
business.summary: The sinking AI trade rattled last week's market. But solid bank earnings and a rotation beyond tech gave us reasons for optimism.

business.title: Data Centers Have a New PR Plan: Your Kid’s Field Trip
business.summary: Amid a wave of backlash, some industry-friendly groups are employing creative and time-tested strategies to woo the youth.

business.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
business.summary: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.

business.title: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo puts the company's status-symbol power to the test
business.summary: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo is drawing early demand as analysts assess whether the foldable can lift iPhone pricing and revenue.

business.title: Anthropic gives outside AI watchdog “employee-like” access
business.summary: The outside watchdog can publish its findings without Anthropic's approval.

business.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
business.summary: Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your

models.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 maps multimodal inputs into a unified vector space
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google DeepMind is an open multimodal embedding model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a single 768-dimensional vector space. It has 740M parameters and runs on consumer hardware.
models.why: Provides low-latency semantic representations for on-device applications like search and RAG.

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces the first MoE model in the series
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 features a 35B-A3B variant, making it the first Mixture of Experts model in the MiniCPM-V series. It enhances single-image, multi-image, and video understanding with efficient on-device inference.
models.why: Brings lossless, smooth on-device vision-language inference via Lookahead Expert Scheduling.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update improves reasoning, coding, and visual benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update improving reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. It reduces execution time and output length to complete tasks faster and cheaper.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B provides fast on-device reasoning with 2B active parameters
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model featuring 2B active parameters. It delivers competitive agentic and tool-use performance while executing efficiently on consumer hardware.
models.why: Enables fast, private on-device reasoning agents with lower compute costs.

models.title: Baidu Unlimited OCR enables one-shot long-horizon document parsing
models.summary: Baidu's Unlimited OCR model supports one-shot long-horizon parsing and integrates with ms-swift for training, vLLM for inference, and is available via Hugging Face Spaces.
models.why: Provides advanced parsing capabilities for computer vision and document understanding pipelines.
